metadata.title: Adavasi Daily |  देखिए आदिवासी भारत की बड़ी ख़बरें और भील प्रदेश की मांग पर क्या बोले आदिवासी नेता
metadata.description: Adivasi daily is a new beginning in the journey of Main Bhi Bharat. It's a bulletin of Tribal India. In Today's Episode watch - why adivasis are demanding separate Bhil Pradesh, Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojna (PMAAGY), Tamil Nadu tribal settlements get community rights under forest rights act.
